summary: Feedback Module: Draft, Submit & View-All/Edit-Own Authorization
description:
Builds the feedback module against the feedback table that already exists in the schema (migration V8__create_feedback.sql: session_id UNIQUE, supporter_id, body, is_submitted, submitted_at, updated_at — one record per session, plain-text body, no rating field) but has zero backend code (backend/api/src/main/java/xyz/catuns/imp/api/feedback is an empty placeholder package on every branch to date).

Supersedes two prior, mutually-inconsistent specs:
- docs/backlog/phase-3-epic-weeks-7-8-feedback-job-search.json's feedback story, which specced a separate POST /sessions/:id/feedback/submit endpoint and 'supporters can only read their own feedback' — using stale apps/api / com.ims package paths that don't match this codebase.
- docs/backlog/phase-4-epic-backend-supporter-api-completion.json's feedback story, which correctly re-specced PATCH-based submit (matching docs/api-reference.md) but kept the 'supporter reads own only' restriction — and was never implemented.

This epic corrects the authorization model per current product direction: any supporter can view feedback for any session (consistent with the already-decided broadened supporter read access for processes/sessions in the Phase 4 completion epic), but a supporter may only create or edit the feedback record for sessions where they are the assigned supporter. Admins and marketers can read any submitted feedback; only the assigned supporter can write.

The supporter feedback UI already exists in frontend/apps/web (components/supporter/feedback-editor.tsx, awaiting-feedback-list.tsx, app/(app)/supporter/sessions/[id]/feedback/page.tsx) but is pure local mock state with no API calls — note this is apps/web, not frontend/apps/dashboard, which currently has no feedback pages at all; confirm which frontend app is the actual target before wiring, since dashboard is where recent branch activity has been concentrated.

Key paths: <backend/api/src/main/java/xyz/catuns/imp/api/feedback>, <backend/api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V8__create_feedback.sql>, <frontend/apps/web/components/supporter/feedback-editor.tsx>
functionality: submit structured feedback after conducting a session, see feedback left by other supporters on any session, but only edit the record for sessions they personally supported
benefit: closes the interview feedback loop for admins/marketers while giving supporters visibility into how prior rounds went, without letting them alter another supporter's assessment

stories.description:
JPA entity mapping to the existing feedback table — no new migration expected, only build against V8 as-is. Service methods: createDraft (409 if a record already exists for the session, since session_id is UNIQUE), updateDraft (409 once is_submitted=true), submit (sets submitted_at server-side and locks further writes), findBySessionId.

Key paths: <backend/api/src/main/java/xyz/catuns/imp/api/feedback/FeedbackEntity.java>, <backend/api/src/main/java/xyz/catuns/imp/api/feedback/repository/FeedbackRepository.java>, <backend/api/src/main/java/xyz/catuns/imp/api/feedback/FeedbackService.java>

acceptanceCriteria.given: no feedback record exists yet for a session
acceptanceCriteria.when: the assigned supporter creates a draft with a body
acceptanceCriteria.then: a feedback record is persisted with is_submitted=false and a 201 response is returned

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Creating a second draft for the same session is rejected
acceptanceCriteria.given: a feedback record already exists for a session
acceptanceCriteria.when: a create is attempted again for that session
acceptanceCriteria.then: a 409 Conflict response is returned, consistent with the session_id UNIQUE constraint
is_submitted becomes true, submitted_at is set server-side, and any further update attempt returns 409

stories.summary: Implement FeedbackController: view all, edit own
stories.description:
Endpoints, all under /sessions/:id/feedback:
- GET: any authenticated admin, marketer, or supporter can read the feedback for any session (no ownership restriction) — this is the corrected rule, replacing 'own only' from both prior specs. Candidates are not permitted.
- POST: creates a draft. supporterId is derived from the JWT, not the request body. 403 if the caller is not the session's assigned supporter (cannot author feedback under another supporter's name, and cannot author feedback for a session they didn't support).
- PATCH: updates the draft or submits it ({ body?, isSubmitted? }). 403 if the caller is not the record's supporterId — admins and marketers can GET but never POST/PATCH.

Key paths: <backend/api/src/main/java/xyz/catuns/imp/api/feedback/FeedbackController.java>, <backend/api/src/main/java/xyz/catuns/imp/api/feedback/dto>

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Any supporter can view feedback on any session
acceptanceCriteria.given: supporter A submitted feedback for a session they supported
acceptanceCriteria.when: supporter B (not assigned to that session) calls GET /sessions/:id/feedback
acceptanceCriteria.then: supporter A's feedback content is returned with a 200 response, not 403 or 404

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Only the assigned supporter can create feedback for a session
acceptanceCriteria.given: a session is assigned to supporter A

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Only the authoring supporter can update their feedback
acceptanceCriteria.given: supporter A authored a draft feedback record for a session
acceptanceCriteria.when: supporter B calls PATCH /sessions/:id/feedback for that session
acceptanceCriteria.then: a 403 Forbidden response is returned and the record is unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Admin and marketer can read but not write feedback
acceptanceCriteria.then: a 200 response is returned; if they attempt POST or PATCH on the same endpoint, a 403 is returned

acceptanceCriteria.when: they call GET, POST, or PATCH /sessions/:id/feedback

tasks.description: camelCase JSON fields per project convention: id, sessionId, supporterId, body, isSubmitted, submittedAt, updatedAt. No @JsonProperty snake_case annotations.

GET: @PreAuthorize hasAnyRole('ADMIN','MARKETER','SUPPORTER'), unscoped. POST/PATCH: @PreAuthorize hasRole('SUPPORTER') plus an ownership check against the session's assigned supporterId (POST) or the feedback record's supporterId (PATCH), resolved from the JWT the same way SessionStatusTransitionService.resolveUserId does.

stories.summary: Wire the supporter feedback UI to the real API
stories.description:
Replace the local mock state in the existing supporter feedback UI with real React Query hooks against the endpoints from the previous story. Add a read-only view for feedback authored by another supporter (view-all), keeping the editable draft/submit flow only when the viewer is the authoring supporter. First confirm with the team whether frontend/apps/web or frontend/apps/dashboard is the intended home for this page, since dashboard has no supporter routes today and has been the focus of recent work.

Key paths: <frontend/apps/web/components/supporter/feedback-editor.tsx>, <frontend/apps/web/components/supporter/awaiting-feedback-list.tsx>, <frontend/apps/web/app/(app)/supporter/sessions/[id]/feedback/page.tsx>

acceptanceCriteria.given: a supporter viewing their own unsubmitted feedback
acceptanceCriteria.then: the editable textarea, autosave PATCH, and submit button behave as today, but now persist to the real API instead of local state

acceptanceCriteria.given: a supporter viewing feedback authored by a different supporter
acceptanceCriteria.then: the content is shown read-only with no save or submit controls

acceptanceCriteria.given: feedback has is_submitted=true, regardless of author
acceptanceCriteria.then: the content is shown read-only with a submitted timestamp
